violation_type.title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))
violation_type.short_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on interviews with staff and observation of the operation confirms rodent feces present in the classrooms. Rodent feces was seen in vicinity of furniture and children's toys.

finding_variants.text: Based on interviews with staff and observation of the operation confirms rodent feces present in the classrooms. Rodent feces was seen in vicinity of furniture and children's toys.
The toilet in the two's and three classrooms contained excrement on the toilet. The wall in the two's classroom had excrement smeared on the wall.

While staff were helping children with naptime, there was food left on the tables and floors of two toddler classrooms.     This was corrected at the inspection when the floors and tables were cleaned.
Three of the five classrooms observed had food remaining on the floors and tables  from lunch.
One of the toilets in the girl's bathroom was observed to have feces on the toilet seat.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the toilet was cleaned.
The caregivers were not using the four step process for cleaning and sanitation.    The Director is going to correct this by having a training on the proper procedures for cleaning and sanitation.
